news.title: Michiel Wolters komt van Boomerang naar team5pm als Creative Director
PwC kiest team5pm als creatief social bureau
Dr. Oetker kiest team5pm als nieuwe social & influencer agency voor 2026

summary: Team5pm is we are a data-driven social agency that redefines advertising in a social-first world. , founded in 2018. Type: startup / scale-up. About 160 employees (LinkedIn page). Not found in the IND sponsor register. 100% of its 1 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.

culture.text: A data-driven social agency, part of SAMY, creating YouTube and TikTok content, influencer campaigns and digital-first ads since 2018.
About 160 people with offices in Amsterdam, Stockholm, Cape Town and Warsaw; clients include Prime Video, IKEA, Volkswagen, bol. and KPN.
Staff mostly studied communication, media or marketing, often at HvA, University of Amsterdam, Inholland or BUas.

open.text: Not listed as an IND recognised visa sponsor.

growth.text: PwC chose team5pm as its creative social agency.
Dr. Oetker picked team5pm as its new social and influencer agency for 2026.

worth_knowing.text: Hired Michiel Wolters from Boomerang as Creative Director.
Its work has won at The YouTube Works, The Webby Awards and the European Search Awards.
